v1.0:
Initial release.

- Browse 281 chord voicings across 99 chord names, covering all 12 root notes with major, minor, 7, m7, maj7, sus2, sus4 and power chord shapes.
- Most chords carry two or three voicings. Left and Right cycle between them, Up and Down move to the next chord in the root's list.
- Practice mode with 14 built-in progressions of two to four chords. Each chord lasts one bar, with a metronome click on every beat and a higher click plus vibro on the chord change.
- Tempo adjustable from 40 to 200 bpm while practicing.
- Both the chord library and the progression list are plain text files on the SD card, so you can add your own without rebuilding the app.
